items.name: almonds
items.preparation: whole, skin-on, raw or dry-roasted, unsalted (about 32 almonds)

scale_cues: White square plate assumed about 20-22 cm across; individual counts of grapes (~14) and almonds (~32) multiplied by typical unit weights (grape ~5 g, almond ~1.2 g).
assumptions: Red round items are small red grapes, not cherry tomatoes, based on dark red colour and glossy round shape
Almonds are plain with no added oil, salt or coating
Almonds are partly piled, so the count allows for a few hidden beneath the visible layer
No dressings, oils or drinks are present
